$comment: Inferred evidence only. What Cursor offered each month, from the cited pages. Never used in a tag. A model is listed from the month a fetched page shows it launched, and stays listed while the current docs/models page still lists it (no retirement notice found). Models Cursor's docs list without a launch date in any fetched page are in undated_models_on_docs_page and are not placed in any month.

undated_models_on_docs_page.note: Names as the docs page writes them on 2026-11-18. No launch dates found for these in fetched pages. Gemini 3.5 Flash is listed in 2026-05 only because a forum post dated 2026-05-27 says the poster had been using it for a while.

2026-05.default: Composer 2.5 Fast (default variant of Composer from 2026-05-18)
2026-05.note: Opus 4.7 launched 2026-04-16, GPT-5.5 2026-04-24, Composer 2.5 2026-05-18 (Composer 2 is its predecessor), Opus 4.8 2026-05-28. Gemini 3.5 Flash availability date not stated; forum post of 2026-05-27 shows it in use. 2026-05-11 changelog says Cursor picks the model automatically for Microsoft Teams requests.

2026-06.note: 2026-06-04 changelog: Composer 2 retired, composer-2 slugs route to Composer 2.5. Claude Fable 5 announced 2026-06-09; forum users reported it missing from 2026-06-13 (availability intermittent). Claude Sonnet 5 announced 2026-06-30. 2026-06-29 changelog says users can pick any frontier model. No default model named.

2026-07.default: Auto (powered by Cursor Router from 2026-07-22; Teams plans on by default)
2026-07.note: Grok 4.5 launched 2026-07-08, GPT-5.6 family 2026-07-09, Claude Opus 5 2026-07-24. Grok 4.5 post says Composer 2.5 remains offered. Claude Fable 5 had reported availability problems in June and early July; its status in July is uncertain.

2026-08.default: Auto (Cursor Router; no specific model named)
2026-08.note: Grok 4.6 launched 2026-08-12. The August changelog entries name no models. The default carries over from the 2026-07-22 Cursor Router entry; no August page restates it.

2026-09.default: Auto (Cursor Router; no specific model named)
2026-09.note: Claude Fable 5.1 announced 2026-09-01, Grok 4.7 blog 2026-09-21, Claude Opus 5.5 available 2026-09-22 per forum reply. The Grok 4.7 blog does not itself say where it is available; the Cursor models docs list it.

2026-10.note: October changelog entries name no model launches. List is carried forward from September because the current docs/models page still lists each of these models. Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 4 models may have launched in September or October but no fetched page dates them.

2026-11.default: Auto (modes Cost, Balance, Intelligence; no default model named)
2026-11.note: Full list on the docs page fetched 2026-11-18. Many third-party models are marked hidden by default. Not a statement about all of November, only about its first 18 days. Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Opus 5 are described in the docs as superseded but still listed.
